description: Compact production overview dashboard for Percona Server for MongoDB Operator. v2 fixes PBM metric names to mongodb_pbm_* and makes oplog panel auto-detect mongodb_oplog_stats_* metrics.

panels.title: Exporter targets up
panels.description: Prometheus scrape availability for MongoDB exporter targets.

targets.expr: sum(up{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: MongoDB up
panels.description: mongodb_up when exported, otherwise scrape up fallback.

targets.expr: sum(mongodb_up{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}) or sum(up{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Pods running
panels.description: Kubernetes running pods matching selected namespace/pod filters.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", phase="Running"})

panels.title: Pod restarts / 1h
panels.description: Restarts in the last hour.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="POD"}[1h]))

panels.title: MongoDB / exporter availability
panels.description: Use this to distinguish MongoDB connection failure from Prometheus scrape failure.

targets.expr: avg by (pod, instance) (mongodb_up{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})
avg by (pod, instance) (up{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Replica member state
panels.description: Replica state labels from Percona exporter. Some older/compatible setups expose the second metric.

targets.expr: max by (pod, instance, rs_nm, rs_state) (mongodb_rs_members_state{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", rs_nm=~"$replica_set"})
max by (pod, instance, rs_nm, rs_state) (mongodb_mongod_replset_member_state{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", rs_nm=~"$replica_set"})

panels.title: Replication lag
panels.description: Lag per secondary/member. If empty, check exact replSetGetStatus metric names in your exporter.

targets.expr: max by (pod, instance, rs_nm) (mongodb_rs_members_replication_lag{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", rs_nm=~"$replica_set"})
max by (pod, instance, rs_nm) (mongodb_mongod_replset_member_replication_lag{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", rs_nm=~"$replica_set"})

panels.title: Oplog window / oplog stats
panels.description: Auto-detects Percona exporter oplog stats. Prefer mongodb_oplog_stats_* time/window metrics from diagnosticdata. If empty, enable --collector.diagnosticdata or --collect-all on mongodb_exporter and verify metrics with {__name__=~"mongodb_oplog_stats_.*"}.

targets.expr: max by (__name__, pod, instance, rs_nm) ({__name__=~"mongodb_oplog_stats_.*(time|window|diff).*", job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})

max by (pod, instance, rs_nm) (mongodb_rs_oplog_head_timestamp{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", rs_nm=~"$replica_set"} - mongodb_rs_oplog_tail_timestamp{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", rs_nm=~"$replica_set"})
count({__name__=~"mongodb_oplog_stats_.*", job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Operations / sec
panels.description: serverStatus opcounters. Supports common Percona new/compatible naming.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (rate(mongodb_ss_opcounters{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))
sum by (op_type) (rate(mongodb_op_counters_total{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

panels.title: Document operations / sec
panels.description: Documents returned/inserted/updated/deleted where available.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (rate(mongodb_ss_metrics_document{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))
sum by (op_type) (rate(mongodb_mongod_metrics_document_total{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

panels.title: Operation latency avg
panels.description: Average operation latency if opLatencies metrics are available.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (rate(mongodb_mongod_op_latencies_latency_total{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / sum by (type) (rate(mongodb_mongod_op_latencies_ops_total{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

sum by (type) (rate(mongodb_ss_opLatencies_latency{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / sum by (type) (rate(mongodb_ss_opLatencies_ops{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

panels.title: Queued reads/writes
panels.description: Global lock current queue. Useful saturation symptom.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (mongodb_ss_globalLock_currentQueue{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})
sum by (type) (mongodb_mongod_global_lock_current_queue{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Current/available/total created connections depending on exporter labels.

targets.expr: sum by (conn_type) (mongodb_ss_connections{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})
sum by (state) (mongodb_connections{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Connection utilization
panels.description: Connection usage. Alert-worthy when sustained high.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(mongodb_ss_connections{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", conn_type="current"}) / (sum(mongodb_ss_connections{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", conn_type="current"}) + sum(mongodb_ss_connections{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", conn_type="available"}))

100 * sum(mongodb_connections{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", state="current"}) / (sum(mongodb_connections{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", state="current"}) + sum(mongodb_connections{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", state="available"}))

panels.title: WiredTiger cache used
panels.description: WiredTiger cache pressure. Exact metric name differs by exporter mode/version.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(mongodb_ss_wt_cache_bytes_currently_in_the_cache{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}) / sum(mongodb_ss_wt_cache_maximum_bytes_configured{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})

100 * sum(mongodb_wiredtiger_cache_bytes_currently_in_cache{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}) / sum(mongodb_wiredtiger_cache_maximum_bytes_configured{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: WiredTiger dirty cache
panels.description: Dirty cache ratio, useful for checkpoint/write pressure.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(mongodb_ss_wt_cache_tracked_dirty_bytes_in_the_cache{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}) / sum(mongodb_ss_wt_cache_maximum_bytes_configured{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})

100 * sum(mongodb_wiredtiger_cache_tracked_dirty_bytes_in_cache{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}) / sum(mongodb_wiredtiger_cache_maximum_bytes_configured{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: WiredTiger cache activity
panels.description: Cache read/write/eviction activity.

targets.expr: sum(rate(mongodb_ss_wt_cache_pages_read_into_cache{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))
sum(rate(mongodb_ss_wt_cache_pages_written_from_cache{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

sum(rate(mongodb_ss_wt_cache_unmodified_pages_evicted{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) + sum(rate(mongodb_ss_wt_cache_modified_pages_evicted{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

panels.title: WiredTiger tickets available
panels.description: Read/write ticket availability. Low values indicate storage engine contention.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (mongodb_ss_wt_concurrentTransactions_available{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})
sum by (type) (mongodb_mongod_wiredtiger_concurrent_transactions_available_tickets{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU usage and requested CPU per pod.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m]))
sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="cpu"})

panels.title: Memory working set
panels.description: Container memory working set and requested memory per pod.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"})
sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory"})

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: CPU throttling ratio. Sustained throttling can show as MongoDB latency/lag.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])) / sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])) * 100

panels.title: Network I/O
panels.description: Pod network receive/transmit throughput.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))
sum by (pod) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))

panels.title: PVC used
panels.description: Persistent volume utilization.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$pvc"}) / max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$pvc"})

panels.title: PVC available bytes
panels.description: Free bytes by PVC.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", persistentvolumeclaim=~"$pvc"})

panels.title: PBM configured / PITR enabled
panels.description: Uses actual Percona exporter metrics mongodb_pbm_cluster_backup_configured and mongodb_pbm_cluster_pitr_backup_enabled. Shows 0 if the PBM collector is absent or PBM is not configured.

targets.expr: max(mongodb_pbm_cluster_backup_configured{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}) or on() vector(0)
max(mongodb_pbm_cluster_pitr_backup_enabled{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance"}) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: PBM backup age by status
panels.description: Age since last PBM backup transition, grouped by status/type/name. Actual metric: mongodb_pbm_backup_last_transition_ts. Filter to status="done" in the query if you only want successful backup age.

targets.expr: time() - max by (status, type, name, replica_set) (mongodb_pbm_backup_last_transition_ts{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", replica_set=~"$replica_set"})

panels.title: PBM agent status
panels.description: Actual metric: mongodb_pbm_agent_status. Values: 0=OK, 1=error, 2=lost.

targets.expr: max by (host, replica_set, role, self) (mongodb_pbm_agent_status{job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", instance=~"$instance", replica_set=~"$replica_set"})

options.content:
### Metric compatibility notes

This dashboard is intentionally compact and portable. If a panel is empty, first verify the metric exists in Explore.

#### Oplog
The v2 oplog panel auto-detects `mongodb_oplog_stats_*` metrics:

```promql
{__name__=~"mongodb_oplog_stats_.*", job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace"}
```

If this is empty, enable `--collector.diagnosticdata` or `--collect-all` on `percona/mongodb_exporter`. Some older/compat dashboards used head/tail timestamp metrics; current exporter commonly exposes oplog stats under the `mongodb_oplog_stats_*` prefix.

#### PBM
PBM metrics are not generic `pbm_backup_*`. Current Percona exporter exposes them as:

```promql
mongodb_pbm_cluster_backup_configured
mongodb_pbm_cluster_pitr_backup_enabled
mongodb_pbm_agent_status
mongodb_pbm_backup_size_bytes
mongodb_pbm_backup_last_transition_ts
mongodb_pbm_backup_duration_seconds
```

Verify with:

```promql
{__name__=~"mongodb_pbm_.*", job=~"$mongodb_job", namespace=~"$namespace"}
```

If empty, enable `--collector.pbm` and ensure the exporter MongoDB user can read PBM internal collections in the `admin` database.

#### Useful discovery queries

```promql
{__name__=~"mongodb_.*connections.*", job=~"$mongodb_job"}
{__name__=~"mongodb_.*opcounters.*|mongodb_.*op_counters.*", job=~"$mongodb_job"}
{__name__=~"mongodb_.*wt.*cache.*|mongodb_.*wiredtiger.*cache.*", job=~"$mongodb_job"}
{__name__=~"mongodb_.*rs.*|mongodb_.*repl.*", job=~"$mongodb_job"}
```

title: PSMDB Operator / MongoDB Overview — v2 metric-compatible
